title: The Last Wolf Anew
author: August Oyelaran
blurb: Orsen Whitlock, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
